header: The SQL the model wrote stays on the server (my decision, 22 Nov 2026). The search bar no longer shows it, and a screen that does not show it must not receive it either: it spells out the tables and columns of the directory to anybody who opens the browser's network tab. The server keeps it (public.nl2sql_log, and one line in the server log in development: src/lib/nl2sql/log.ts), so a wrong answer can still be checked. I use this on the answer that is about to leave the search route, next to maskAnswer. Pure: it returns a copy.

symbols.name: withoutSql
doc: Returns the same answer with the `sql` of every `nl2sql` block emptied; I keep the field, as an empty string, so the shape of the answer does not change.

behaviours: ...and nothing else of the block changes
the answer given is not changed (a copy)
no table or column name is left anywhere in the text that leaves
an answer without a model block is returned as it is
a block nested deeper is emptied too
null, text and numbers pass through
the search route empties the SQL on its way out
the answer extras draw no SQL
the model's 'Understood as' line is not drawn (the other lookups keep theirs)
the SQL is written to the server log in development
